description: ZeroG Pulse is an autonomous deep-space telemedicine HUD featuring a 5-organ digital twin simulation, 30-minute clinical deterioration predictor, and bilingual voice integration aligned with NASA-STD-3001 and ECLSS thresholds. Built by Computer Science students at Egyptian Chinese University to solve deep-space medical autonomy during communication blackouts. Check out our live app at zerog-pulse.vercel.app!
